title: Collatz: boundary rigidity, triadic certificates, and residual denominators
body:
## Current checkpoint — 23 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** Two new checkpoints attack the full convergence witness, unrestricted cycle cancellation, and the ordinary endpoint law. The latest continuation derives a positive Haar component from a specified higher-rank averaging of the actual canonical boundary, and tests arithmetic rationality and holonomicity directly on ordinary data.

**Published head:** [53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/commit/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739)

## 1. Higher-rank rigidity with verified invariance and entropy

Retain the canonical common real-boundary law from PR180, including its positive-floor, whole-path-selection and information-dimension qualifications. For one hypothetical escaping odd source, let q_j=U^j(p), chi_j=3^j/2^A_j, and let sigma_j be the law of iota(-chi_j Z) in

    X_6 = (R × Q_2 × Q_3) / diagonal Z[1/6].

The explicit enlarged average is

    lambda_(N,L) = (1/(NL)) sum_(j<N) sum_(ell<L) (×2^ell)_* sigma_j.

The actual edge identity proves

    TV((×2)_*lambda, lambda) <= 1/L
    TV((×3)_*lambda, lambda) <= A_N/(NL) + 1/N.

The **explicit schedule L=N²** preserves positive doubling entropy. Scaling and reduction modulo one cost only O_p(N) bits uniformly over the moving roots, while the input real entropy is evaluated at precision N². A finite block argument handles the limit, including possible dyadic boundary atoms.

Einsiedler–Lindenstrauss Theorem 1.2 then applies to the established joint action. Every weak limit has

    lambda = c Haar_(X_6) + (1-c) lambda_0, with c >= d0 > 0,

where the remainder has zero entropy on all jointly ergodic components. This is a **source-qualified written theorem**, not an assertion that the unthickened orbit itself equidistributes.

The same note applies Einsiedler–Kleinbock's countable-union box-dimension-zero exceptional-set theorem to the actual boundary, using positive information dimension after every fixed absolutely continuous reweighting. It proves almost-sure mixed-Littlewood approximation for that actual law.

[Higher-rank theorem, actual-law approximation, and exact remaining conversion](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/literature/HIGHER_RANK_BOUNDARY_ATTACK.md)

**Unresolved transfer:** the unthickened conditional fibres have weight p0/N² in the enlarged average; nothing locates that particular submeasure in its Haar part. The compact quotient also erases the exact integer translation in D A = A D + (1,1,1), which changes the ordinary endpoint. The required growing-resolution collision upper bound remains unproved. Unrestricted Diophantine approximants have not been converted into the required dyadic denominator, exact Syracuse numerator, and integral intermediate states.

## 2. Direct arithmetic-rationality and distinguished-fibre attacks

The Borel–Dwork continuation uses the actual parity series B_n and weighted state series A_n. Their exact relation is

    (2-z) A_n(z) = 2n + z B_n(z), with B_n(2)=-n in Q_2.

For a hypothetical escaping ordinary source, the same B_n has the positive real value n(Lambda_infinity^(-1)-1) at 2. Its arithmetic formal-model hypothesis holds, but the directly available adelic convergence-radius product is 3^(rho_minus-rho_plus)<=1. The isolated 2-adic cancellation and the tested core factor 3-z² do not supply the meromorphic continuation with positive capacity required by Bost–Chambert-Loir. Shaped continuation domains remain open.

[Actual parity series and the primary rationality interface](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/literature/BOREL_DWORK_ACTUAL_PARITY_ATTEMPT.md)

The Hankel route gives exact unrestricted identities:

    Delta_n(u) = ±Res(F_0,Q_0)
    Delta_n(u) = (-1)^n F_0(3) Delta_n(v)
    Delta_(n+1)(v(t)) = (-1)^n Delta_n(u) (F_0(3)t+Q_0(3)).

Thus the full-rank determinant is the norm condition, while the first larger border is the original distinguished-fibre equation. A complete rational control has all shifted full-rank determinants integral despite its nonintegral initial state.

The Calegari–Dimitrov–Tang arithmetic-holonomicity interface was tested explicitly. Recurrence degree is not its rational-function-field independence dimension. The natural small-archimedean normalization also has an exact dyadic integrality cost

    M exp(-Lambda) <= m 2^kappa < 2 M exp(Lambda),

bringing in the maximum orbit state M where the proposed contradiction needs control by the minimum m. The proposed estimate log m >= c*n remains OPEN; even that estimate would initially leave an effective finite-range cycle check.

[Hankel identities, exact control, and arithmetic holonomicity](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/literature/HANKEL_AND_HOLONOMICITY_ATTACK.md)

## 3. Preserved new Lean and all-word denominator results

The preceding checkpoint e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158 remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

- **Core/Std Lean:** a signed triadic complementary candidate has a strictly decreasing lexicographic rank. The executable stopClock is total for every candidate, and finite_valid_triadic_reaches_one consumes only parity checks through that finite computed clock. Universal successful-witness existence remains open.
- **Written triadic interface:** Omega(n) in Z[1/3] iff the shortcut orbit reaches 1. The 2-adic construction itself is not claimed as formalized in Lean. Concurrent PR178 work proving the same criterion and signed rank is explicitly cross-credited.
- **All primitive words, p>=10:** the residual degree satisfies n > (log p)^2/(72 log(2 log p)). With PR185's separately source-qualified factor gap, D_pol grows faster than every fixed power of p, uniformly in the word. This is after polynomial gcd removal and BEFORE the remaining integer gcd. No full numerical nondivisibility is asserted.
- **Actual-component constructions:** a path mixture gives an auxiliary null-recurrent network without predecessor-density assumptions; equal-depth sibling transport has total excess gap at least log2(N!)−O_p(N). Neither statement proves deterministic recurrence or the missing collision upper bound.

[TriadicDual.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/TriadicDual.lean) · [Degree/denominator proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_DENOMINATOR.md) · [Prior science and all scopes](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/README.md)

It was not an audit of every file on every branch. Exact records are preserved in [the refresh report](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/53ba1e1ffc46bf022433c2124a62682ad8dd4739/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov23/risk24/README.md).
